method: resample real MNI152NLin6Asym T1w onto real MNI152NLin2009cAsym reference grid using as-stored composite vs GetInverse; score against actual 2009c template

inverse.note: SimpleITK Transform.GetInverse() throws 'Unable to create inverse!' on the DisplacementFieldTransform composite; not required

conclusion: TemplateFlow ITK h5 is authored as the pull-back transform: sitk.Resample(moving=<NLin6-space image>, reference=<2009c grid>, transform=<h5 as-stored>, linear, 0) produces anatomically correct NLin6->2009c output (Dice 0.973 against the true 2009c template). No inversion needed.
implication_for_toolchain: transform_brainnetome_to_julich2009c.py applies the composite AS-STORED (no GetInverse).
